queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Global VPN Client' AND publisher LIKE '%SonicWall%';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Global VPN Client' AND publisher LIKE '%SonicWall%' AND version_compare(version, '5.0.0.2008') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'swgvc.exe');
